about_the_game:
This is a visual novel AVG with female omega as the protagonist.
① On a summer slope with the clamor of cicadas, you will begin this story, gradually understand the experiences of the three main characters, and determine their endings in the story.
② You can read text by clicking with the left mouse button, scrolling with the scroll wheel, or using spaces.
③ The game has 2 strategy routes, with a total of 7 endings. The single line clearance time is about 2-3 hours, and the total word count for the entire ending is 21w+.

matters needing attention
Due to engine limitations, there may be the following issues during the gaming process:
① When there are too many archives, the engine is very easy to flash or get stuck. It is recommended to archive 1-5 for the best.
② During cg switching, white may flash in the upper left corner of the screen, which is a normal phenomenon.
③ When viewing phone information, it will automatically play and cannot control the speed, which is the default setting for the engine.
④ After playing the phone information/during chapter switching, the previous conversation may be repeated. Simply click to continue.
⑤ Clicking too fast may cause the vertical drawing to not disappear properly. You can try reading the latest file again.

Thank you for your play and support. Every comment you make will be a great encouragement to me.
